title: Rigidification independence over complete strictly local regular rings
statement: Fix the quotient-resolution construction and fan resolution rule described in [lem-per-rigidified-quotient-tower-comparison]. Let $X=\coprod_{i=1}^m\operatorname{Spec}A_i$, where $m$ is finite and each $A_i$ is a complete Noetherian regular local ring with separably closed residue field [def-weil-regular-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Let a finite group $G$ act tamely on $X$, with abelian geometric inertia and freely outside a $G$-strict strict normal crossings boundary $B$ [def-trf-strict-normal-crossings-boundary]. Let $\overline B$ and $\overline B'$ be two invariant normal crossings boundaries containing $B$ such that each enlarged divisorial log structure is very tame [def-trf-fs-log-blowup]. Resolve the log quotients for these two rigidifications by the fixed rule, pull back in fs log schemes, and retain the underlying normalized blowup towers with ordered centers. The two resulting towers on $X$ are equal, including the order and the defining ideal sheaves of all centers. The equality also holds for a finite disjoint union with permuted components; it is not merely equality of contracted towers on each separate component.

source.place: VIII Lemma 5.5.2 and proof, printed pp.127--128; characteristic-zero independence used there is Theorem 3.4.15, printed pp.113--114.
